submission.title: Center symmetry on the lattice: twist invariance, Polyakov-loop covariance and the ⟨χ(P)⟩ = 0 selection rule
submission.claim: For any group G, central element z, d, L ≥ 1 and direction τ on the periodic lattice (ℤ/Lℤ)^d, the Lean theorem Contribution.result proves four things. (1) The center twist multiplies every τ-link leaving one slice x_τ = t₀ by z. It leaves every plaquette, and hence every plaquette action (Wilson or otherwise, no class-function hypothesis), exactly invariant. (2) The Polyakov loop P_b (from accepted pr-12) is gauge covariant, P_b(gU) = g_b P_b(U) g_b⁻¹. The twist of the slice through b multiplies it by z, P_b ↦ z P_b. So χ(P_b) is gauge invariant for class functions χ, yet charged under the center. (3) Selection rule: let E be any ℂ-linear expectation on observables that is invariant under the twist. If χ(z h) = ω χ(h) with ω ≠ 1 (e.g. χ = tr in the fundamental of SU(N), z = e^{2πi/N}), then E(χ∘P_b) = 0. This is the lattice form of the statement that an unbroken center symmetry forces a vanishing Polyakov-loop expectation, the classic confinement order parameter ('t Hooft; Svetitsky–Yaffe). (4) Applying pr-12's axial gauge to the twisted configuration, the residual last-slice link equals z times the original Polyakov loop. The twist is visible exactly in the gauge-fixed residual data. Item (2) also supplies the precise covariance statement that the pr-12 review asked for: the Polyakov element is covariant by conjugation, and its class-function evaluations are invariant.
submission.novelty: This builds on accepted track results pr-12 (lines, Polyakov loops, axial gauge; its theorem is used in part (4)) and pr-10 (plaquettes, gauge action, plaquette actions). No accepted track contribution treats center symmetry. The mathematics is classical ('t Hooft 1978; Svetitsky–Yaffe 1982; Polyakov 1978). In the external Lean library lgt (Douglas), a search of commit b8793ccf found no center, Polyakov or twist statements. New relative to the track: an exact formal center twist for arbitrary groups; invariance of all plaquette actions under it; gauge covariance of Polyakov loops; their exact center charge; the abstract linear-expectation selection rule; and the combination with the pr-12 axial gauge.

submission.limitations: This is classical, configuration-level infrastructure. The expectation E in (3) is an arbitrary twist-invariant linear functional. The Haar/Wilson Gibbs measure is not constructed here, and its twist invariance is not proved; that needs Haar measure invariance under multiplication by z. The rule therefore gives ⟨χ(P)⟩ = 0 only once such a measure-level invariance is supplied, and it says nothing about spontaneous breaking, the deconfinement transition or area-law confinement. The twist is stated for a single slice; for (2)–(3) the slice passes through the Polyakov base point. Nothing here constructs the continuum theory or proves a mass gap.

{
  "version": 2,
  "imports": [
    "Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Basic",
    "Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Basic",
    "Mathlib.Algebra.Module.LinearMap.Defs"
  ],
  "source": "namespace Contribution

open B_fe98bbfbfb97628232bb09c5964d9ee6fa045bd4f96501a460ab0583772ba5a2.Contribution
open B_4f4126122d0700524796c405e145badf09c1ce0f46ce2280744811f1b2bad118.Contribution

variable {G : Type} [Group G] {d L : ℕ}

/-- `z` lies in the center of `G`. -/
def IsCentral (z : G) : Prop := ∀ h : G, z * h = h * z

/-- The center transformation: right-multiply every `τ`-link leaving the slice `x_τ = t₀`
by `z`. -/
def centerTwist (z : G) (τ : Fin d) (t₀ : ZMod L) (U : LinkConfig G d L) :
    LinkConfig G d L :=
  fun x μ => if μ = τ ∧ x τ = t₀ then U x μ * z else U x μ

theorem twist_ne (z : G) (τ : Fin d) (t₀ : ZMod L) (U : LinkConfig G d L) (x : Site d L)
    {μ : Fin d} (h : μ ≠ τ) : centerTwist z τ t₀ U x μ = U x μ :=
  if_neg fun hh => h hh.1

theorem twist_on (z : G) (τ : Fin d) (t₀ : ZMod L) (U : LinkConfig G d L) {x : Site d L}
    {μ : Fin d} (hμ : μ = τ) (h : x τ = t₀) : centerTwist z τ t₀ U x μ = U x μ * z :=
  if_pos ⟨hμ, h⟩

theorem twist_off (z : G) (τ : Fin d) (t₀ : ZMod L) (U : LinkConfig G d L) {x : Site d L}
    {μ : Fin d} (h : x τ ≠ t₀) : centerTwist z τ t₀ U x μ = U x μ :=
  if_neg fun hh => h hh.2

theorem shift_coord (x : Site d L) {τ ν : Fin d} (h : τ ≠ ν) : (x + e ν : Site d L) τ = x τ := by
  rw [Pi.add_apply, e_ne h, add_zero]

theorem cancel_first {z : G} (hz : IsCentral z) {a' b' c' f' : G} (a b c f : G)
    (ha : a' = a * z) (hb : b' = b) (hc : c' = c * z) (hf : f' = f) :
    a' * b' * c'⁻¹ * f'⁻¹ = a * b * c⁻¹ * f⁻¹ := by
  rw [ha, hb, hc, hf, mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc a z b, hz b, ← mul_assoc a b z, mul_assoc (a * b) z,
    mul_inv_cancel_left]

theorem four_links {a' b' c' f' : G} (a b c f : G)
    (ha : a' = a) (hb : b' = b) (hc : c' = c) (hf : f' = f) :
    a' * b' * c'⁻¹ * f'⁻¹ = a * b * c⁻¹ * f⁻¹ := by
  subst ha hb hc hf; rfl

/-- Plaquettes with first direction `τ` are unchanged by a center twist. -/
theorem plaquette_centerTwist_first {z : G} (hz : IsCentral z) (τ : Fin d) (t₀ : ZMod L)
    (U : LinkConfig G d L) (x : Site d L) {μ ν : Fin d} (hμ : μ = τ) (hμν : μ ≠ ν) :
    plaquette (centerTwist z τ t₀ U) x μ ν = plaquette U x μ ν := by
  have hντ : ν ≠ τ := fun h => hμν (hμ.trans h.symm)
  by_cases ht : x τ = t₀
  · exact cancel_first hz _ _ _ _ (twist_on z τ t₀ U hμ ht) (twist_ne z τ t₀ U _ hντ)
      (twist_on z τ t₀ U hμ ((shift_coord x (Ne.symm hντ)).trans ht)) (twist_ne z τ t₀ U x hντ)
  · exact four_links _ _ _ _ (twist_off z τ t₀ U ht) (twist_ne z τ t₀ U _ hντ)
      (twist_off z τ t₀ U (fun h => ht ((shift_coord x (Ne.symm hντ)).symm.trans h)))
      (twist_ne z τ t₀ U x hντ)

/-- Every plaquette is unchanged by a center twist. -/
theorem plaquette_centerTwist {z : G} (hz : IsCentral z) (τ : Fin d) (t₀ : ZMod L)
    (U : LinkConfig G d L) (x : Site d L) (μ ν : Fin d) :
    plaquette (centerTwist z τ t₀ U) x μ ν = plaquette U x μ ν := by
  by_cases hμν : μ = ν
  · cases hμν
    exact (plaquette_self _ x μ).trans (plaquette_self U x μ).symm
  by_cases hμ : μ = τ
  · exact plaquette_centerTwist_first hz τ t₀ U x hμ hμν
  by_cases hν : ν = τ
  · exact (plaquette_swap _ x ν μ).trans ((congrArg (·⁻¹)
      (plaquette_centerTwist_first hz τ t₀ U x hν (Ne.symm hμν))).trans
      (plaquette_swap U x ν μ).symm)
  · exact four_links _ _ _ _ (twist_ne z τ t₀ U x hμ) (twist_ne z τ t₀ U _ hν)
      (twist_ne z τ t₀ U _ hμ) (twist_ne z τ t₀ U x hν)

/-- Every plaquette action (no class-function hypothesis needed) is center-twist invariant. -/
theorem latticeAction_centerTwist [NeZero L] {z : G} (hz : IsCentral z) (τ : Fin d)
    (t₀ : ZMod L) (f : G → ℝ) (U : LinkConfig G d L) :
    latticeAction f (centerTwist z τ t₀ U) = latticeAction f U := by
  unfold latticeAction
  simp only [plaquette_centerTwist hz]

/-! ### Telescoping along a line (abstract sequences) -/

theorem conj_step (gb P h u j : G) : gb * P * h⁻¹ * (h * u * j⁻¹) = gb * (P * u) * j⁻¹ := by
  rw [mul_assoc h u, mul_assoc (gb * P), inv_mul_cancel_left, ← mul_assoc (gb * P) u,
    ← mul_assoc gb P u]

theorem tele_gauge (g P Q u : ℕ → G) (hP0 : P 0 = 1) (hP : ∀ k, P (k + 1) = P k * u k)
    (hQ0 : Q 0 = 1) (hQ : ∀ k, Q (k + 1) = Q k * (g k * u k * (g (k + 1))⁻¹)) :
    ∀ k, Q k = g 0 * P k * (g k)⁻¹
  | 0 => by rw [hQ0, hP0, mul_one, mul_inv_cancel]
  | k + 1 => by rw [hQ, tele_gauge g P Q u hP0 hP hQ0 hQ k, hP, conj_step]

theorem tele_twist {z : G} (hz : IsCentral z) (N : ℕ) (P Q u : ℕ → G) (hP0 : P 0 = 1)
    (hP : ∀ k, P (k + 1) = P k * u k) (hQ1 : Q 1 = u 0 * z)
    (hQ : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k < N → Q (k + 1) = Q k * u k) :
    ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ N → Q k = z * P k := by
  intro k hk
  induction k, hk using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => intro _; rw [hQ1, hP, hP0, one_mul, hz]
  | succ k hk ih =>
    intro hkN
    rw [hQ k hk hkN, ih (Nat.le_of_lt hkN), hP, mul_assoc]

theorem add_L_smul_e [NeZero L] (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) : b + L • e τ = b := by
  funext μ
  rw [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, nsmul_eq_mul, ZMod.natCast_self, zero_mul, add_zero]

theorem shift_succ (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) (k : ℕ) :
    b + k • e τ + e τ = b + (k + 1) • e τ :=
  (add_assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg (b + ·) (succ_nsmul _ k).symm)

/-- Polyakov loops transform by conjugation at their base point. -/
theorem polyakovLoop_gaugeAct [NeZero L] (g : GaugeTransform G d L) (U : LinkConfig G d L)
    (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) :
    polyakovLoop (gaugeAct g U) b τ = g b * polyakovLoop U b τ * (g b)⁻¹ := by
  have h := tele_gauge (fun k => g (b + k • e τ)) (linePath U b τ)
    (linePath (gaugeAct g U) b τ) (fun k => U (b + k • e τ) τ) rfl (fun _ => rfl) rfl
    (fun k => congrArg (fun p => linePath (gaugeAct g U) b τ k *
      (g (b + k • e τ) * U (b + k • e τ) τ * (g p)⁻¹)) (shift_succ b τ k)) L
  rw [polyakovLoop, polyakovLoop, h, zero_smul, add_zero, add_L_smul_e]

theorem coord_ne [NeZero L] (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) {k : ℕ} (h1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk : k < L) :
    (b + k • e τ : Site d L) τ ≠ b τ := by
  rw [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, e_self, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  intro h
  have h0 : ((k : ℕ) : ZMod L) = 0 := add_eq_left.mp h
  rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff] at h0
  exact absurd (Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt h0 hk) (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mp h1)

/-- A center twist at the slice through `b` multiplies the Polyakov loop at `b` by `z`. -/
theorem polyakovLoop_centerTwist [NeZero L] {z : G} (hz : IsCentral z) (τ : Fin d)
    (U : LinkConfig G d L) (b : Site d L) :
    polyakovLoop (centerTwist z τ (b τ) U) b τ = z * polyakovLoop U b τ := by
  have hb0 : (b + (0 : ℕ) • e τ : Site d L) τ = b τ := by rw [zero_smul, add_zero]
  exact tele_twist hz L (linePath U b τ) (linePath (centerTwist z τ (b τ) U) b τ)
    (fun k => U (b + k • e τ) τ) rfl (fun _ => rfl)
    ((one_mul _).trans (twist_on z τ (b τ) U rfl hb0))
    (fun k h1 hk => congrArg (linePath (centerTwist z τ (b τ) U) b τ k * ·)
      (twist_off z τ (b τ) U (coord_ne b τ h1 hk)))
    L NeZero.one_le le_rfl

/-- Selection rule: an expectation invariant under the center twist through `b` annihilates
every Polyakov-loop observable at `b` of nontrivial center charge `ω ≠ 1`. -/
theorem fixed_zero {x ω : ℂ} (h : x = ω * x) (hω : ω ≠ 1) : x = 0 := by
  have h3 : (ω - 1) * x = 0 := by rw [sub_mul, one_mul, ← h, sub_self]
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h3).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hω)

theorem expectation_polyakov_eq_zero [NeZero L] {z : G} (hz : IsCentral z) (τ : Fin d)
    (b : Site d L) (χ : G → ℂ) (ω : ℂ) (hχ : ∀ h, χ (z * h) = ω * χ h) (hω : ω ≠ 1)
    (E : (LinkConfig G d L → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ)
    (hE : ∀ F : LinkConfig G d L → ℂ, E (fun U => F (centerTwist z τ (b τ) U)) = E F) :
    E (fun U => χ (polyakovLoop U b τ)) = 0 :=
  fixed_zero ((hE _).symm.trans ((congrArg E (funext fun U =>
    (congrArg χ (polyakovLoop_centerTwist hz τ U b)).trans (hχ _) :
      (fun U => χ (polyakovLoop (centerTwist z τ (b τ) U) b τ)) =
        ω • (fun U : LinkConfig G d L => χ (polyakovLoop U b τ)))).trans
    (map_smul E ω _))) hω

/-- Center symmetry of lattice gauge theory on `(ℤ/Lℤ)^d`, for any group `G`, central `z`
and direction `τ`: (1) every plaquette action is invariant under the center twist of any
slice; (2) Polyakov loops are gauge covariant (conjugated at the base point), and the twist
of the slice through `b` multiplies the Polyakov loop at `b` by `z`; (3) every twist-invariant
linear expectation annihilates `χ ∘ P_b` whenever `χ(z h) = ω χ(h)` with `ω ≠ 1`; (4) in the
axial gauge of pr-12, the twisted configuration's residual link on the last slice is `z`
times the original Polyakov loop. -/
theorem result :
    ∀ (G : Type) [Group G] (d L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (z : G), IsCentral z → ∀ τ : Fin d,
      (∀ (t₀ : ZMod L) (f : G → ℝ) (U : LinkConfig G d L),

      (∀ (U : LinkConfig G d L) (b : Site d L),

        ∀ g : GaugeTransform G d L,
          polyakovLoop (gaugeAct g U) b τ = g b * polyakovLoop U b τ * (g b)⁻¹) ∧
      (∀ (b : Site d L) (χ : G → ℂ) (ω : ℂ), (∀ h, χ (z * h) = ω * χ h) → ω ≠ 1 →
        ∀ E : (LinkConfig G d L → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ,
          (∀ F : LinkConfig G d L → ℂ, E (fun U => F (centerTwist z τ (b τ) U)) = E F) →
          E (fun U => χ (polyakovLoop U b τ)) = 0) ∧
      (∀ (U : LinkConfig G d L) (x : Site d L), (x τ).val + 1 = L →
        ∃ g : GaugeTransform G d L,
          gaugeAct g (centerTwist z τ (sliceBase x τ τ) U) x τ =
            z * polyakovLoop U (sliceBase x τ) τ) := by
  intro G _ d L _ z hz τ
  refine ⟨fun t₀ f U => latticeAction_centerTwist hz τ t₀ f U,
    fun U b => ⟨polyakovLoop_centerTwist hz τ U b, fun g => polyakovLoop_gaugeAct g U b τ⟩,
    fun b χ ω hχ hω E hE => expectation_polyakov_eq_zero hz τ b χ ω hχ hω E hE,
    fun U x hx => ?_⟩
